Get Now
CookieAdmin: Simple GDPR, CCPA & DPDPA Compliant Cookie Banner
Lightweight, Powerful 
Cookie Consent Banner 
Plugin for WordPress
Privacy compliance shouldn’t be complicated. With CookieAdmin, you can effortlessly manage cookie consent banners on your WordPress site, ensuring you meet GDPR, CCPA, DPDPA privacy laws without sacrificing performance or design.
  • GDPR & CCPA
  • DPDPA (India)
  • Customizable Banner
  • Consent Logs
Get Started
Download Now
Why Choose CookieAdmin?
CookieAdmin makes WordPress privacy compliance simple and stress-free. Discover why businesses, marketers, and developers count on it and why it’s the perfect fit for your website as well!
Features
CookieAdmin is one of the best WordPress Cookie Consent plugins available. Packed with powerful features, it offers a complete solution for WordPress privacy compliance, making it one of the most comprehensive tools on the market.
Fully Compliant
Stay on the right side of privacy laws like GDPR, CCPA, DPDPA and more
Customizable Design
Match the banner to your brand's look and feel with easy styling options
Lightweight & Fast
No bloat, no slowdown - keep your website speedy
Granular Consent Control
Let users accept, reject, or customize which cookies they allow
Easy Integration
Seamless setup with simple configuration options right in your WordPress dashboard
Self Hosted
All visitor data is saved in your WordPress database allowing you full control over the data
Consent Logs
Track Consent Logs from your WordPress admin panel. Export the consent logs in CSV format
Scan Cookies
One Click Scan & Categorize Cookies used on your website for better transparency
Support
Got questions ? Our support team is available to help you with any questions you may have
Accessibility Compliant
The Consent Banner is compliant with ADA, EAA & WCAG acts.
Google Consent Mode v2
Enable Google Consent Mode v2 for better compliance.
Multilingual
Supports 17+ languages to customize the consent banner in your native language.
All Features
Get the Leading WordPress Plugin for Cookie and Consent Management
Design fully customizable Cookie Consent banners, track user consent, and handle all your privacy compliance needs quickly and efficiently, all from your WordPress dashboard.
Download Now
FAQs
CookieAdmin is a WordPress plugin that helps you create customizable cookie banners, manage user consent, and stay compliant with global privacy laws like GDPR, CCPA, and more.
Yes! The Cookie Consent Banner is fully customizable to adapt your branding. You can change color as well as content that should be displayed on the banner. You can also choose the location of the banner to be displayed on your website. 
Yes! It includes a built-in cookie scanner that automatically detects and categorizes cookies used on your site for better accuracy and compliance.
Absolutely. CookieAdmin stores the visitors' country as well as the IP address. The IP address is anonymized to comply with the privacy laws. 
All consent data is securely stored in your own WordPress database, giving you full control and keeping everything self-hosted for maximum privacy.
